values.goal: Make the repository policy and typed publication path require every implementation PR body to include the correct GitHub closing keyword for its issue, normally Closes #<issue>.
values.required_outcome: A small policy/tooling change that prevents publication of implementation PRs without an actual GitHub closing keyword and documents the rule in AGENTS.md.
declared_scope: Root AGENTS.md implementation PR publication rule
C-SDLC v2 publication request and remote PR body linkage validation
authority_boundary: Use typed C-SDLC v2 lifecycle and repo-native GitHub tooling only
Do not rewrite the broader workflow or closeout model
Asynchronous typed closeout remains separate and nonblocking
operator_constraints: Keep artifacts in the issue worktree
PR body for this issue must include Closes #5692
